---
title: "QC-espresso - DIA"
subtitle: "Quality control report for DIA proteomics data"
author:
  - name: "Guilherme Lanfredi"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
version: "`r trimws(readLines(file.path('..', 'VERSION'), n = 1L, warn = FALSE))`"
abstract: >
  This report provides a structured quality control assessment of
  data-independent acquisition (DIA) proteomics experiments processed with
  DIA-NN. The analysis supports instrument performance monitoring, dataset
  validation, and QC tracking.
params:
  report_path: null
  fasta_path: null
  output_dir: null
format:
  html:

    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    toc-location: left
    fig-responsive: false
    fig-width: 8
    fig-height: 5
    fig-dpi: 144
    embed-resources: true
execute:

  message: false
  warning: false
  error: true
  freeze: false
editor: visual
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

QMD_DIR <- normalizePath(
  dirname(knitr::current_input()),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

PROJECT_ROOT <- normalizePath(
  file.path(QMD_DIR, ".."),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

qc_version <- trimws(
  readLines(
    file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "VERSION"),
    n = 1L,
    warn = FALSE
  )
)

library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(microseq)
library(knitr)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)

source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "globals.R"))
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "io_load.R"))

n_runs <- dplyr::n_distinct(report$Run)
IS_LARGE_BATCH <- n_runs > 12L
```

```{r}
#| label: runs-removed-by-global-filtering
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

if (
  exists("runs_removed_by_global_filter") &&
    is.data.frame(runs_removed_by_global_filter) &&
    nrow(runs_removed_by_global_filter) > 0L
) {
  removed_run_names <- paste(
    as.character(runs_removed_by_global_filter$Run),
    collapse = ", "
  )

  removed_run_count <- nrow(runs_removed_by_global_filter)

  cat("::: {.callout-warning}\n")
  cat("## Runs excluded by global confidence filtering\n\n")
  cat(
    "**",
    removed_run_count,
    " acquisition run(s) were completely removed after decoy exclusion and ",
    "application of `PG.Q.Value <= 0.01`.**\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat("**Affected run(s):** ", removed_run_names, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(
    "These runs are absent from downstream QC outputs because no entries ",
    "remained after the initial confidence filter.\n"
  )
  cat(":::\n")
}
```

# 1. Identification performance

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Identification depth

This section reports identification depth per run at the precursor, peptide, and protein-group levels.
:::

```{r}
#| label: identification-numbers
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-width: 8

invisible(source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "qc_identification.R")))
```

```{r}
#| label: identification-table

total_ids_table_note <- report |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Peptides = dplyr::n_distinct(Modified.Sequence),
    Precursors = dplyr::n_distinct(Precursor.Id),
    Protein.Groups = dplyr::n_distinct(Protein.Group)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    note = paste0(
      "TOTAL across all runs - Peptides: ", scales::comma(Peptides),
      "; Precursors: ", scales::comma(Precursors),
      "; Protein Groups: ", scales::comma(Protein.Groups)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(note)

id_depth_summary |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = "Identification Depth per Run",
    subtitle = "Precursors, peptides, and protein groups"
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_integer(columns = c(Precursors, Peptides, Protein.Groups)) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(source_note = gt::md(total_ids_table_note)) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.width = gt::pct(100),
    container.height = gt::px(400),
    container.overflow.y = "scroll"
  )
```

# 3. Sequence coverage

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Protein sequence coverage

Coverage is calculated independently for each FASTA accession. For multiprotein groups, shared peptide evidence may contribute to more than one compatible sequence, but no quantitative signal is duplicated.
:::

```{r}
#| label: sequence-coverage
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 7

invisible(source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "qc_coverage.R")))
```

```{r}
#| label: sequence-coverage-table

if (
  exists("coverage_results_top100") &&
    is.data.frame(coverage_results_top100) &&
    nrow(coverage_results_top100) > 0L
) {
  coverage_results_top100 |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::tab_header(
      title = "Protein Sequence Coverage Summary (Top 100)",
      subtitle = "Full peptide evidence is exported as CSV"
    ) |>
    gt::cols_label(
      Protein.Group = "Accession",
      Protein.Name = "Protein Name",
      Total_Len = "Length (aa)",
      Aminoacids_Covered = "Covered AA",
      Coverage_Pct = "Coverage (%)"
    ) |>
    gtExtras::gt_plt_bar_pct(
      column = Coverage_Pct,
      scaled = TRUE,
      fill = "#56B4E9",
      background = "white",
      labels = TRUE
    ) |>
    gt::tab_options(
      table.width = gt::pct(100),
      container.height = gt::px(500),
      container.overflow.y = "scroll"
    )
} else {
  cat("Protein coverage summary not available.\n")
}
```

```{r}
        Median_RT_Deviation_min,

        Missed_Cleavage_Pct,
        Charge2_Pct,
        Charge3_Pct,
        Contaminant_Pct
      ),
      decimals = 2
    ) |>
    gt::tab_options(
      table.width = gt::pct(100),
      container.height = gt::px(400),
      container.overflow.y = "scroll"
    )
} else {
  cat("Figures of merit not available.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: ion-mobility-availability

im_candidates <- c(
  "IM",
  "Ion.Mobility",
  "Precursor.Ion.Mobility",
  "1/K0"
)

im_col <- im_candidates[im_candidates %in% colnames(report)][1]
HAS_VALID_ION_MOBILITY <- FALSE

if (!is.na(im_col)) {
  im_values <- report[[im_col]]
  im_values <- im_values[!is.na(im_values) & im_values != 0]

  if (length(im_values) > 0L) {
    HAS_VALID_ION_MOBILITY <- (
      dplyr::n_distinct(im_values) >= 10L &&
        stats::sd(im_values, na.rm = TRUE) > 1e-4
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: ion-mobility-heading
#| results: asis

if (isTRUE(HAS_VALID_ION_MOBILITY)) {
  cat("# 11. Ion mobility\n\n")
  cat("::: {.callout-note collapse=\"true\"}\n")
  cat("## Ion mobility\n\n")
  cat("This section evaluates precursor density in m/z and ion-mobility space and, when predicted mobility is available, compares observed and predicted trends.\n")
  cat(":::\n")
}
```
